name: Windcaller Aven — the cycling trigger's picker leaves out the card cycled
notes: "When you cycle this card, target creature gains flying until end of turn." The card is cycled from the hand, so it cannot be a target; the picker listed Windcaller Aven itself. Same for "When you discard this card" and for a trigger whose every event takes the card off the battlefield (dies, leaves the battlefield, "When you cycle this card and when this creature dies").
